title: W74's Miscellaneous Building Blocks
description: This mod adds random blocks and sets of blocks I find useful in decorating.
body:
This mod adds various blocks and/or sets of blocks I find useful when building. Some of them might be designed with copycats+ in mind.

~~Since I'm lazy,~~ Porting and reuse of assets is fully permitted, as long as credit is given.

Versions below 2.0.0 have been made using MCreator.
